### Q01: INNER JOIN - orders with their customer and region (only matching rows)

```sql
INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
INNER JOIN regions   r ON r.region_id   = c.region_id

ORDER BY o.order_date
```

### Q05: FULL OUTER JOIN - reconcile customers vs. regions that have sales reps
```sql
-- Shows regions with no customers OR customers with no region (unmatched on either side)
SELECT r.region_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS employees
FROM customers c
FULL OUTER JOIN regions r   ON r.region_id = c.region_id
FULL OUTER JOIN employees e ON e.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY r.region_name;
```

### Q06: CROSS JOIN - build a complete region x category grid (including zero-sales cells)
```sql
WITH top_cat AS (SELECT category_id, name FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL),
     grid AS (
        SELECT r.region_id, r.region_name, t.category_id, t.name AS category
        FROM regions r CROSS JOIN top_cat t
     ),
     sales AS (
        SELECT c.region_id,
               COALESCE(cat.parent_id, cat.category_id) AS root_cat,   -- only 2 levels deep for most
               SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
        FROM order_items oi
        JOIN orders o    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
        JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
        JOIN products p  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
        JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
        GROUP BY c.region_id, root_cat
     )
SELECT g.region_name, g.category, ROUND(COALESCE(s.revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.region_id = g.region_id AND s.root_cat = g.category_id
ORDER BY g.region_name, g.category;
```

### Q09: SELF JOIN - pairs of products in the same category with price gap (avoid duplicate pairs with <)
```sql
SELECT a.name AS product_a, b.name AS product_b, cat.name AS category,
       ABS(a.unit_price - b.unit_price) AS price_gap
FROM products a
JOIN products b ON a.category_id = b.category_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = a.category_id
ORDER BY price_gap DESC
LIMIT 8;
```

### Q10: MULTI-TABLE JOIN (7 tables) - sales rep performance by region and category
```sql
SELECT e.name AS sales_rep,
       r.region_name AS rep_region,
       cat.name AS category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o       ON o.order_id    = oi.order_id
JOIN employees e    ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
JOIN regions r      ON r.region_id   = e.region_id
JOIN products p     ON p.product_id  = oi.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN customers c    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY e.name, r.region_name, cat.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

### Q13: MULTIPLE AGGREGATIONS - one pass, many metrics per product
```sql
SELECT p.name,
       COUNT(*)                       AS line_items,
       SUM(oi.quantity)               AS units,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.discount) * 100, 1) AS avg_discount_pct,
       MIN(oi.discount)               AS min_disc,
       MAX(oi.discount)               AS max_disc,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)), 2) AS gross_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o   ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 8;
```

### Q15: CONDITIONAL AGGREGATION (FILTER / CASE) - status mix per region in a single row
```sql
SELECT r.region_name,
       COUNT(*)                                           AS total_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'completed')     AS completed,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled')     AS cancelled,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'returned')      AS returned,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS return_rate_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN regions r   ON r.region_id = c.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY total_orders DESC;
```

### Q17: ROLLUP (emulated) - region subtotals and grand total.
```sql
-- SQLite lacks ROLLUP, so we UNION ALL the grouping levels.
-- PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server equivalent:  GROUP BY ROLLUP (region_name, year)
WITH base AS (
    SELECT r.region_name,
           strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS year,
           oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) AS rev
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN regions r   ON r.region_id = c.region_id
)
SELECT region_name, year, ROUND(SUM(rev), 2) AS revenue FROM base GROUP BY region_name, year
UNION ALL
SELECT region_name, 'ALL YEARS', ROUND(SUM(rev), 2) FROM base GROUP BY region_name          -- subtotal
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ALL REGIONS', 'ALL YEARS', ROUND(SUM(rev), 2) FROM base                             -- grand total
ORDER BY 1, 2;
```

| East        | 2025      | 108124.25 |
| East        | ALL YEARS | 143622.75 |

### Q18: CUBE (emulated) - every combination of (region, category-root) subtotals
```sql
-- Native:  GROUP BY CUBE (region_name, category)   -> 2^2 = 4 grouping sets
WITH base AS (
    SELECT r.region_name,
           COALESCE(parent.name, cat.name) AS category,
           oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) AS rev
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o       ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN customers c    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN regions r      ON r.region_id = c.region_id
    JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    LEFT JOIN categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_id
)
SELECT region_name, category, ROUND(SUM(rev),2) AS revenue FROM base GROUP BY region_name, category   -- (region, category)
UNION ALL SELECT region_name, '*', ROUND(SUM(rev),2) FROM base GROUP BY region_name                    -- (region)
UNION ALL SELECT '*', category, ROUND(SUM(rev),2) FROM base GROUP BY category                          -- (category)
UNION ALL SELECT '*', '*', ROUND(SUM(rev),2) FROM base                                                 -- ()
ORDER BY 1, 2
LIMIT 14;
```

## 03_window_functions.sql

### Q19: ROW_NUMBER vs RANK vs DENSE_RANK - how ties behave (compare the three columns)
```sql
SELECT p.name, p.unit_price,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.unit_price DESC) AS row_num,    -- always unique 1,2,3,4...
       RANK()       OVER (ORDER BY p.unit_price DESC) AS rnk,        -- ties share rank, then GAP
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.unit_price DESC) AS dense_rnk   -- ties share rank, NO gap
FROM products p
ORDER BY p.unit_price DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

### Q20: PARTITION BY - top 2 products by revenue inside each category
```sql
WITH prod_rev AS (
    SELECT cat.name AS category, p.name AS product,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o       ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    GROUP BY cat.name, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM prod_rev
)
SELECT category, product, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY category, rn;
```

### Q21: Share of total using SUM() OVER () and a partitioned share
```sql
WITH cat_rev AS (
    SELECT cat.name AS category,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o       ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    GROUP BY cat.name
)
SELECT category,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_total,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rev_rank
FROM cat_rev
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
```

### Q22: RUNNING TOTAL - cumulative monthly revenue (SUM OVER with ORDER BY)
```sql
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS running_total
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;
```
| month   | revenue  | running_total |
|---------|----------|---------------|

### Q23: RUNNING TOTAL per partition - cumulative revenue that RESETS each year
```sql
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS year,
           strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS mon,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY year, mon
)
SELECT year, mon, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY mon), 2) AS ytd_revenue
FROM monthly
ORDER BY year, mon
LIMIT 14;
```

### Q24: LAG - month-over-month growth %
```sql
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS prev_month,
       ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
             / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 1) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;
```

### Q25: LAG with offset 12 - year-over-year comparison for the same month

```sql
    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY month
)
```

### Q27: MOVING AVERAGE - 3-month rolling average smooths volatility
```sql
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS ma_3m,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS ma_6m
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;
```

### Q28: NTILE + FIRST_VALUE - customer spend quartiles and gap to the top spender in their region
```sql
WITH spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.region_id,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_spend
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o       ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.region_id
)
SELECT name, region_id, ROUND(total_spend, 2) AS total_spend,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS spend_quartile,
       ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(total_spend) OVER (PARTITION BY region_id ORDER BY total_spend DESC) - total_spend, 2) AS gap_to_region_top
FROM spend
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 8;
```

### Q37: MULTIPLE (chained) CTEs - customer segmentation: Champion / Regular / At-risk
```sql
WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS spend,
           MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o       ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
),
reference AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_date) AS as_of FROM orders
),
scored AS (
    SELECT cs.*, CAST(julianday(r.as_of) - julianday(cs.last_order) AS INTEGER) AS days_inactive
    FROM customer_stats cs CROSS JOIN reference r
)
SELECT CASE WHEN spend >= 6000 AND days_inactive <= 90 THEN 'Champion'
            WHEN days_inactive > 180                    THEN 'At-risk'
            ELSE 'Regular' END AS segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       ROUND(AVG(spend), 2) AS avg_spend,
       ROUND(AVG(days_inactive), 0) AS avg_days_inactive
FROM scored
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY avg_spend DESC;
```

|----------|-----------|-----------|-------------------|
| Champion | 17        | 10599.44  | 46.0              |
| Regular  | 32        | 8970.95   | 126.0             |
| At-risk  | 6         | 5869.0    | 244.0             |

### Q38: RECURSIVE CTE - org chart with depth and full reporting path
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE org AS (
    SELECT employee_id, name, title, manager_id, 0 AS depth, name AS path
    FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL                       -- anchor member
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.employee_id, e.name, e.title, e.manager_id, org.depth + 1,
           org.path || ' > ' || e.name
    FROM employees e JOIN org ON e.manager_id = org.employee_id   -- recursive member
)
SELECT substr('          ', 1, depth * 2) || name AS indented_name, title, depth, path
FROM org
ORDER BY path;
```

### Q39: RECURSIVE CTE - category tree rolled up: revenue for a root category incl. all descendants
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
    SELECT category_id, name, category_id AS root_id, name AS root_name
    FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.category_id, c.name, t.root_id, t.root_name
    FROM categories c JOIN tree t ON c.parent_id = t.category_id
)
SELECT t.root_name AS top_level_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS products,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM tree t
JOIN products p     ON p.category_id = t.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o       ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY t.root_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
```

| Home               | 6        | 129888.0  |

```sql
monthly AS (
```

### Q41: RECURSIVE CTE - referral chain depth: who sits at the bottom of the longest referral chain
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
    SELECT customer_id, name, referred_by, 0 AS depth, CAST(customer_id AS TEXT) AS trail
    FROM customers WHERE referred_by IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.referred_by, chain.depth + 1, chain.trail || '>' || c.customer_id
    FROM customers c JOIN chain ON c.referred_by = chain.customer_id
)
SELECT depth, COUNT(*) AS customers_at_depth, MAX(trail) AS example_trail
FROM chain
GROUP BY depth
ORDER BY depth;
```

### Q43: Quarterly revenue by region with rank inside each quarter
```sql
WITH q AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) || '-Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter,
           r.region_name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN regions r      ON r.region_id = c.region_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY quarter, r.region_name
)
SELECT quarter, region_name, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank_in_quarter
FROM q
ORDER BY quarter DESC, rank_in_quarter
LIMIT 8;
```

### Q44: Day-of-week seasonality - which weekday sells most
```sql
SELECT CASE strftime('%w', o.order_date)
            WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed'
            WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END AS weekday,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY strftime('%w', o.order_date)
ORDER BY strftime('%w', o.order_date);
```

### Q45: Rep leaderboard with quota attainment (quota = 1.25 x average rep) and rank
```sql
WITH rep_rev AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id, e.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN employees e    ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.name
)
SELECT name,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank,
       ROUND(100.0 * revenue / (1.25 * AVG(revenue) OVER ()), 1) AS quota_attainment_pct
FROM rep_rev
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
```

### Q46: New vs returning customers per month (cohort-style, using MIN order date per customer)
```sql
WITH first_order AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_date
    FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date = f.first_date THEN o.customer_id END) AS new_customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date > f.first_date THEN o.customer_id END) AS returning_customers
FROM orders o
JOIN first_order f ON f.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month DESC
LIMIT 6;
```

### Q47: Market basket - product pairs most often bought together (self join on order_items)
```sql
SELECT p1.name AS product_a, p2.name AS product_b, COUNT(*) AS times_together
FROM order_items a
JOIN order_items b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
JOIN products p1   ON p1.product_id = a.product_id
JOIN products p2   ON p2.product_id = b.product_id
GROUP BY p1.name, p2.name
ORDER BY times_together DESC, product_a
LIMIT 6;
```

| Wireless Mouse    | Bluetooth Speaker | 16             |
| Bluetooth Speaker | Gaming Monitor    | 15             |
| USB-C Hub         | Office Chair      | 15             |

### Q48: Pareto / ABC analysis - what % of products drive 80% of revenue
```sql
WITH prod AS (
    SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o   ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.name
),
cum AS (
    SELECT name, revenue,
           SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) * 1.0 / SUM(revenue) OVER () AS cum_share
    FROM prod
)
SELECT name, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(100 * cum_share, 1) AS cumulative_pct,
       CASE WHEN cum_share <= 0.80 THEN 'A' WHEN cum_share <= 0.95 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS abc_class
FROM cum
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
```

| Air Laptop 13           | 122407.5 | 50.7           | A         |

### Q49: Customer retention - months between first and each later order (cohort age)
```sql
WITH first_o AS (
    SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(order_date)) AS cohort
    FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT f.cohort,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS cohort_size,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) > f.cohort THEN f.customer_id END) AS came_back_later
FROM first_o f
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = f.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY f.cohort
ORDER BY f.cohort
LIMIT 6;
```

| 2024-03 | 1           | 1               |

### Q50: Best-selling product per region using ROW_NUMBER over a multi-join CTE
```sql
WITH rp AS (
    SELECT r.region_name, p.name AS product,
           SUM(oi.quantity) AS units,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN regions r   ON r.region_id = c.region_id
    JOIN products p  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY r.region_name, p.name
)
SELECT region_name, product, units FROM rp WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY region_name;
```

|-------------|----------------|-------|
| East        | Wireless Mouse | 47    |
| North       | Webcam HD      | 40    |
| South       | Coffee Maker   | 59    |
| West        | Air Fryer      | 43    |
